title:
This type provides the context for evaluating {@link ImplLanguage.Runtime.EnvVar#value}. Any field or method in this type can be
used in the expression for {@link ImplLanguage.Runtime.EnvVar#value}. For any `Runtime` with {@link ImplLanguage.RuntimeBase#installEnvVars} or {@link ImplLanguage.RuntimeBase#runEnvVars}, an instance of this type will be created during runtime installation/execution to evaluate the {@link ImplLanguage.Runtime.EnvVar#value}.
name: ImplLanguage.Runtime.Context
